config.text:
name = "uav-operator-day8-laguna-t1-diagnostic"
model = "poolside/Laguna-XS-2.1"
loss = "rl"
max_steps = 1

batch_size = 16
rollouts_per_example = 2
max_inflight_rollouts = 4
learning_rate = 3e-5
lora_alpha = 32

[sampling]
max_tokens = 1024
temperature = 0.7
enable_thinking = false

[[env]]
id = "jarrett/uav-operator@0.1.1"
args = { tier = "T1", dataset_split = "train", max_examples = 8, max_turns = 40 }

[eval]
interval = 1
num_examples = 2
rollouts_per_example = 2
skip_first_step = false

[[eval.env]]
id = "jarrett/uav-operator@0.1.1"
args = { tier = "T1", dataset_split = "dev", max_examples = 2, max_turns = 40 }

[eval.sampling]
max_tokens = 1024
temperature = 0.0
enable_thinking = false

[checkpoints]
interval = 1
keep_cloud = 1

[adapters]
interval = 1
keep_last = 1

free_tier_environment_eligibility.detail: Prime model and environment-status responses expose no free-tier eligibility field, and /rft/runs/preview returns HTTP 405.

hub_status.description: A multi-turn UAV operations environment where models manage drone missions under wind, airspace, and failure events.
hub_status.name: uav-operator

failures: free-tier model/environment eligibility is not affirmatively confirmed
summary.note: Ordinary inference-catalog absence is recorded but is not a preflight failure; Hosted Training is the compatibility test.
